Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

station — a place where trains stop. Example: The station is near my house.
airport — a place where planes take off. Example: The airport is far from the city.
stop — a place where a bus picks up people. Example: The bus stop is on the corner.
ticket — a paper that lets you travel. Example: I buy a ticket to London.
bus — a large road vehicle for many people. Example: I go to work by bus.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• Where is the ...?
• It is near the ...
• At the station
• At the airport
• Buy a ticket at the ticket office.

Grammar focus: Prepositions of transport (by bus, on foot).
Use at for stations and stops, and at for airports too: at the station, at the bus stop, at the airport. Buy a ticket at the ticket office.
